why: rc9 for the owner's in-game test

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc9 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

New: a Colours page (zone / spell / NPC / class / item / term / object names in the colour you pick, classes in their official colour; off by default, switch it on in the page). Fixed: the quest pane showing the previous quest after a quick second click on the map quest log; the same long Persian line appearing twice in a tooltip.

Includes rc8 (settings side menu) and rc7.
